The structure of ZrAg crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms and 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Zr centers each surrounded by 12 geometric neighbors of the opposite element at 3.0512 Å, forming close-packed-like local arrangements. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Ag–Zr and Zr–Ag 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner, edge, and face sharing.
